games.title: Trail
games.blurb: Race along a path: roll the die, jump ahead, slide back, wait a turn. First to the flag wins.

games.title: Checkers
games.blurb: Jump your opponent's pieces, chain your jumps, crown your kings.

games.title: Quest
games.blurb: A turn-based battle: attack, guard or drink a potion. Fight a run of monsters or duel a classmate.

games.title: Paddle Rally
games.blurb: Left and right, then bottom, then top. Miss the ball and lose a life; the last player in wins.
games.author: Steven Huff
games.modeText: 2 to 4 players, one keyboard or online
